OnboardingComeHere_minDriveToFaceDistanc.blurb: Per-instance stop distance (mm) for the OnboardingComeHere “come here” behavior (DriveToFace class). If Vector’s horizontal distance to the target face’s head is already ≤ this value, he skips the approach and plays the “already at face” reaction. JSON default is 200 mm.
OnboardingComeHere_minDriveToFaceDistanc.detail: Registered with MakeMemberTunable as GetDebugLabel() + “_minDriveToFaceDistanceKey_mm” (category BehaviorDriveToFace). Bound to InstanceConfig.minDriveToFaceDistance_mm, which is also seeded from behavior JSON. OnboardingComeHere sets animDriveOverride to OnboardingComeHere, so when he is *not* already close he does not DriveToPose by (distToHead − this); he plays that override animation instead. The tunable still controls the already-close gate (IsRobotAlreadyCloseEnoughToFace) that chooses AlreadyCloseEnough vs the override path. Sibling production Come Here uses the same class without an override and really drives to this standoff. ANKI_DEV_CHEATS only.

OnboardingComeHere_timeUntilCancelFaceTr.blurb: Per-instance console knob that would set how long (seconds) OnboardingComeHere keeps tracking a face after arriving. On the shipping onboarding JSON this has no effect: tracking after approach is turned off for this instance.
OnboardingComeHere_timeUntilCancelFaceTr.detail: DriveToFace always MakeMemberTunable-binds InstanceConfig.timeUntilCancelTracking_s under name timeUntilCancelFaceTrack_s (UI id OnboardingComeHere_timeUntilCancelFaceTrack_s). The value is only loaded from JSON when trackFaceOnceKnown is true, and TransitionToTrackingFace returns immediately when that flag is false—never scheduling trackEndTime_s or a TrackFaceAction. onboardingComeHere.json sets trackFaceOnceKnown: false and omits timeUntilCancelFaceTrack_s, so the member is unused for this behavior instance. Contrast PRDemoComeHere / ComeHereVoiceCommand (tracking on, default 5 s).
OnboardingComeHere_timeUntilCancelFaceTr.statusNote: Registered MakeMemberTunable, but onboardingComeHere.json has trackFaceOnceKnown:false, so TransitionToTrackingFace never reads timeUntilCancelTracking_s. Changing this console var cannot alter onboarding come-here behavior unless that JSON flag is changed in config and the behavior is rebuilt/reloaded.

PRDemoComeHere_minDriveToFaceDistanceKey.blurb: Per-instance standoff distance (mm) for PRDemoComeHere (DriveToFace). Vector drives forward by max(0, distance-to-face-head − this), and if already ≤ this distance he treats the face as close enough and plays AlreadyAtFace. JSON default is 200 mm.
PRDemoComeHere_minDriveToFaceDistanceKey.detail: Same MakeMemberTunable path as other DriveToFace instances (uniqueName = behavior debug label + key; category BehaviorDriveToFace). PRDemoComeHere has no animDriveOverride, so TransitionToDrivingToFace really issues DriveToPoseAction toward a pose translated by (distToHead − minDrive), with cliff-aware shortening. Also used by IsRobotAlreadyCloseEnoughToFace after FindFaceAndThen. Gated to PR demo via FeatureGate PRDemo=true on the behavior. Live at next drive/close check after you edit the console var (member reference, not construct-only copy). ANKI_DEV_CHEATS only.

PRDemoComeHere_timeUntilCancelFaceTrack_.blurb: How long (seconds) PRDemoComeHere keeps actively tracking the found face after the drive (or already-close path) before the behavior cancels itself. JSON default is 5.0 s. Requires trackFaceOnceKnown (true by default for this instance).
PRDemoComeHere_timeUntilCancelFaceTrack_.detail: When TransitionToTrackingFace runs, trackEndTime_s = current time + this value; BehaviorUpdate in State::TrackFace CancelSelf() when time expires. Also starts a TrackFaceAction with a short max time without a visible face (hardcoded 1 s). PRDemoComeHere omits trackFaceOnceKnown so it defaults true; time is parsed from JSON and re-tunable via console. After success anim / already-close / drive-override paths, tracking is the usual finish. Sibling of ComeHereVoiceCommand_timeUntilCancelFaceTrack_s. ANKI_DEV_CHEATS only.
